edits.before: let mut backend = rig.backend(&[start_line()], "0.3", "not a relay line\n", Then::StayOpen);

doc_append:
Three additional original final-drain cases explicitly select the same driver:
invalid cue, malformed relay line, and unobserved listening readiness. They
retain their original line authoring, 300 ms release, 800 ms dispatch target
and assertions. A complete malformed line counts only after the real reader
queues its parse error; the backend's final drain still decides protocol
failure.

In the readiness case, the first dispatch still withholds until the runner
observes the pending `ListeningReady`. The original `next_event(now)` returns
that event without advancing the clock. The original second injection at the
same logical time performs its own final drain and must start the recording-only
player once. It needs no additional clock advance or release.
